body: DeepSeek-VL2: Mixture-of-Experts Vision-Language Models for Advanced Multimodal Understanding
plain_description: **Analyze images and documents with AI that can answer visual questions and recognize text.** It can also understand tables, charts, and object locations in images.
technical_description: DeepSeek-VL2 is a Mixture-of-Experts vision-language model family with Tiny, Small, and full variants. It supports visual question answering, OCR, document/table/chart understanding, visual grounding, and conversations about one or more images. The README demonstrates local inference through Python and a Gradio web demo; it reports GPU memory needs of up to 80 GB or more for some variants, with incremental prefilling enabling VL2-Small on 40 GB.
title: DeepSeek-VL2
